name: Dumbbell curl

phases.name: curl
phases.cue: Curl the dumbbells to your shoulders

phases.name: lower
phases.cue: Lower slowly until your arms are long

formTips: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward
Pin your elbows by your sides; only your forearms move
Curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders and squeeze
Lower slowly until your arms are fully long again
commonMistakes: Swinging the body or leaning back to lift the weight
Letting the elbows drift forward as the dumbbells rise
Cutting the range short at the bottom
Dropping the dumbbells instead of lowering them
